STYLE:

ultra cinematic 1990s dark anime aesthetic, traditional Japanese ukiyo-e influence, mature seinen atmosphere, highly detailed kimono patterns, dramatic red-and-black color palette, moonlit pleasure district, cinematic lighting, deep shadows, emotional visual storytelling, hand-painted anime backgrounds, vintage cel animation feeling, dark elegance, mysterious atmosphere, violent beauty, Japanese noir fantasy.

FOCUS:

strong visual storytelling, elegant tension, seductive manipulation, emotional suspense, dangerous beauty, cinematic character acting, traditional Japanese atmosphere, subtle foreshadowing, dramatic reveals, psychological tension, immersive worldbuilding.

CHARACTER DESIGN:

Kurenai（紅影）

A legendary oiran courtesan in Yoshiwara, long straight black hair with elaborate red-and-gold kanzashi ornaments, pale porcelain skin, crimson eyes, luxurious black-and-red floral kimono, elegant movements, mysterious smile, graceful yet deadly presence, captivating beauty hiding an assassin’s nature.

TARGET MAN

A wealthy merchant in his thirties, refined appearance, dark traditional haori, completely enchanted by Kurenai’s beauty, unaware of the danger approaching.

WORLD DESIGN:

The story takes place in the red-light district of Yoshiwara during the Edo period. Lantern-lit wooden buildings, moonlit bridges, flowing cherry blossoms, crowded banquet rooms, shamisen music, sake cups, gold folding screens, traditional Japanese interiors, drifting flower petals, warm lantern glow contrasting with deep shadows.

[0.0s – 1.2s]

SHOT 01 — YOSHIWARA NIGHT ESTABLISHING.

Extreme wide cinematic shot.

The moon hangs above Yoshiwara. Lantern lights shimmer across wooden bridges and waterways. Cherry blossom petals drift through the night air.

[6.0s – 7.2s]

SHOT 06 — THE INVITATION.

Kurenai smiles and offers a sake cup.

Dialogue:

「さあ、もっと近くへいらっしゃい」

SFX:

酒を注ぐ音

Camera:

Slow forward movement toward Kurenai.

[7.2s – 8.4s]

SHOT 07 — POISONED SAKE.

Extreme close-up.

A hidden blade reflects inside the crimson sake. The liquid shimmers ominously.

SFX:

Camera:

[8.4s – 9.6s]

SHOT 08 — THE STRIKE.

Action shot.

The target drinks. Instantly Kurenai draws a concealed blade. Her kimono and hair ornaments explode outward with motion.

[9.6s – 10.8s]

遠くの談笑

Close-up.

Kurenai places a finger to her lips and smiles softly.

「静かに、ね？」

SFX:

衣擦れ

Camera:

Slow push-in.

[12.0s – 13.5s]

SHOT 11 — BLOOD AND BLOSSOMS.

Stylized symbolic shot.

Cherry blossoms scatter through darkness. A blade flashes across the screen. Crimson petals resemble drops of blood.

Dialogue:

なし

Slow-motion cinematic composition.

[13.5s – 15.0s]

SHOT 12 — THE QUEEN OF YOSHIWARA.

Final wide shot.

Kurenai stands beneath drifting cherry blossoms. Behind her, Yoshiwara glows peacefully as if nothing happened.

Dialogue:

「吉原の華は、私ひとりで十分よ」

Kurenai（紅影）

フォーカス:

強いビジュアルストーリーテリング、優雅な緊張感、誘惑的な操作、感情的なサスペンス、危険な美しさ、シネマティックなキャラクター演技、伝統的な日本の雰囲気、微妙な伏線、劇的な展開、心理的な緊張感、没入感のある世界構築。

キャラクターデザイン:

紅影（くれない）

吉原の伝説的な花魁、長いストレートの黒髪に豪華な赤と金の簪、白磁のような肌、深紅の瞳、豪華な黒と赤の花柄の着物、優雅な動き、神秘的な微笑み、優雅でありながら致命的な存在、暗殺者の本性を隠した魅惑的な美しさ。

ターゲットの男

30代の裕福な商人、洗練された外見、暗い伝統的な羽織、紅影の美しさに完全に魅了され、迫り来る危険に気づいていない。

ワールドデザイン:

物語は江戸時代の吉原の歓楽街で展開される。提灯に照らされた木造の建物、月明かりの橋、流れる桜の花びら、混雑した宴会場、三味線の音楽、酒杯、金の屏風、伝統的な日本のインテリア、漂う花びら、深い影と対照的な暖かい提灯の光。

ESTILO:

ultra cinematic 1990s dark anime aesthetic, influência tradicional japonesa ukiyo-e, atmosfera madura seinen, padrões de quimono altamente detalhados, paleta de cores dramática em vermelho e preto, distrito de prazer iluminado pela lua, iluminação cinematográfica, sombras profundas, narrativa visual emocional, fundos de anime pintados à mão, sensação de animação em cel vintage, elegância sombria, atmosfera misteriosa, beleza violenta, fantasia noir japonesa.

FOCO:

narrativa visual forte, tensão elegante, manipulação sedutora, suspense emocional, beleza perigosa, atuação cinematográfica de personagens, atmosfera tradicional japonesa, sutis presságios, revelações dramáticas, tensão psicológica, construção de mundo imersiva.

DESIGN DE PERSONAGEM:

Kurenai（紅影）

Uma lendária cortesã oiran em Yoshiwara, cabelo preto longo e liso com elaborados ornamentos kanzashi em vermelho e dourado, pele de porcelana pálida, olhos carmesim, quimono floral luxuoso em preto e vermelho, movimentos elegantes, sorriso misterioso, presença graciosa mas mortal, beleza cativante escondendo a natureza de uma assassina.

ALVO

Um rico comerciante na casa dos trinta, aparência refinada, haori tradicional escuro, completamente encantado pela beleza de Kurenai, inconsciente do perigo que se aproxima.

DESIGN DO MUNDO:

A história se passa no distrito da luz vermelha de Yoshiwara durante o período Edo. Edifícios de madeira iluminados por lanternas, pontes sob a luz da lua, flores de cerejeira flutuando, salas de banquete lotadas, música de shamisen, copos de saquê, biombos dourados, interiores tradicionais japoneses, pétalas de flores flutuantes, brilho quente das lanternas contrastando com sombras profundas.
